Definition: a (quasi) sacred person, i.e. (technically) a (male) devotee (by prostitution) to licentious idolatry
BiblicalUsage: The male devotee was a man given to the service of a false god by prostitution: the law forbids any sodomite among the sons of Israel, there were sodomites in the land in Rehoboam's day, Asa took them away out of the land. Jehoshaphat took the remnant of them out of the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word exposes what idolatry does to a people: it does not stay in the shrine, it moves into the streets and the houses by the temple, and a king is judged by whether he removes it. My position is that the kings who cleared it out are the ones Scripture commends, and the ones who let it stand are the ones it condemns.
RelatedPeople: Moses; King Asa; King Jehoshaphat; Rehoboam
